faqs.question: Which CLAT coaching do toppers choose in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Families targeting top-100 ranks often shortlist Knowledge Nation Law Centre first, then Delhi Institute of Law, IMS, Career Launcher, Manu Law Classes, T.I.M.E., and Success Mantra.

faqs.question: How do I verify a coaching institute’s CLAT topper claims?
faqs.answer: Ask for the year, scorecard, NLU allotted, and whether the student bought the same classroom SKU you are purchasing.
